sections.heading: Context
sections.body: The legacy platform had poor mobile usability, limited accessibility support, and no coherent design system—resulting in disengagement and usability drop-offs.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.body: Our outdated digital platform and tech stack hinder user experience and accessibility, especially on mobile, needing an immediate modernization to ensure future growth, expandability and inclusivity.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Improve mobile responsiveness. Enhance accessibility compliance. Optimize performance and load times. Decrease time to identify issues. Increase decision making speed.

sections.heading: Hypothesis
sections.body: Persistent layouts for actions and information regardless of browser viewport size will increase user adoption.

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body: Reworked the information architecture to streamline navigation and content discoverability. Designed a mobile-first UI with accessibility best practices baked in. Collaborated with dev teams to ensure scalable, performance-optimized implementation.

images.caption: More in-house research to address issues

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Achieved 80%+ user adoption before full migration off the legacy system. Enhanced cross-device usability and accessibility. Addressed remaining usability concerns raised by users, reinforcing design decisions.

sections.heading: Learnings
sections.body: This project demonstrated the power of foundational UX improvements. It helped restore user trust, improved system accessibility, and enabled a faster, more scalable design process.

title: Timeline App
summary: Enabled by AI to capture, organize and visualize work

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: Understanding where efforts are spent can help drive behavioural change to focus on impactful work.

image.caption: Snapshot of Timeline app and calendar

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.body: What am I spending my time on at work?

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Centralise todo list. Increase visibility into work. Gain insight into time distribution among tasks. Avoid vendor lock-in and compliance grey zones.

sections.heading: Hypothesis
sections.body: Understanding where my time is spent will enable better time management and effort allocation.

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body: Mapped out requirements for tracking work. Experimented with available apps. Built end-to-end workflows. Pivoted and developed custom app via AI.

images.caption: Shortcuts to capture and transfer data
CSV text data transferred to Numbers
One app to capture, organize and visualize data
Onboarding tutorial and dark mode support

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Developed a flow to capture work via built-in native apps. Simplified requirements to reduce noise. Vibe-coded a todo and visualisation app.

sections.heading: Learnings
sections.body: Iterating constantly to refine requirements and workflows allowed me to vibe-code my own custom app once it became feasible using AI tools.

title: AI Native Design Execution
summary: Use AI to improve design execution workflow by 208%

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: Being at the front of the design and development industry is an expectation of our clients at Lab49. Redefining the design processes enables us to lead our customers into the AI native future.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.body: How to create an AI native design workflow?

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Improve design delivery quality and documentation. Decrease time to first prototype and iterations. Increase cross-functional team communication. Integrate AI into design workflow resourcefully.

sections.heading: Hypothesis
sections.body: Following the lead of software development, solving for design execution will allow design to engage more in the product development lifecycle as a strategic partner.

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body: Created proof of concepts for end-to-end design execution. Developed a design system based UI kit. Experimented with AI agents to hand-off subprocesses.

images.caption: Proof of concept output to Figma
Figma design vs AI output from prototype

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: 3.5x faster design prototyping and showcasing. Reduced time spent on design documentation by 67%. Simplified decision making and task oriented communication. Standardized design process and improved quality.

image.caption: Estimation of efficiency gains and snapshot of rollout

sections.heading: Learnings
sections.body: Developing better design processes that use AI tools enables new possibilities to deliver design impact at every step of the process.

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: The company's expectations of designers' competencies were opaque to the team. The design team struggled to decipher career paths and work needed to get promoted.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.body: How to develop subject matter experts who also have strong craft skills in design teams?

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Discover team competency strengths and areas of improvement. Gain understanding of team competency composition. Consolidate competency proficiency. Support individual up-skilling and becoming subject matter experts.

sections.heading: Hypothesis
sections.body: Matching designers' interest and skill set to development goals will help build both a happier team and reliable subject matter experts.

sections.heading: Actions
sections.body: Coordinated and organized team to workshops to baseline expectations. Map out relevant skills to be tracked. Plan and execute on input gathering. Visualize the input. Explore learning material and support up-skilling.

images.caption: Self, peer and manager ratings of skill

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Developed a workflow to capture and visualize competencies individually and by groups. Transparently discuss competency mapping outcome with team members. Support, coach and mentor designers on their specific learning goals.

sections.heading: Learnings
sections.body: Transparency in expectations and confidence in competencies was valued by the team and supported by the organization.
